title: Cragstone Reinforcements Camp
subtitle: Guruk Colossus spawns for Brogosh's kill task

notes.title: Colossus count and respawn
notes.body: 20 Colossi are placed here (17 on level -6, 3 on level -12), each from a 3-minute generator. One pass is enough for 20, two for 30.

notes.title: Best element
notes.body: Frost and piercing weapons do the most damage to Guruk Colossi (cold 70%, pierce 75%). Avoid acid (10%) and lightning (20%).

notes.title: Levers and Guardian doors
notes.body: Two Guardian doors at the north edge of the Colossus area (52, -70) and (108, -70) are opened by levers. Each door has a lever beside it and a second one in the middle room at (80, -45). Pull any lever for each door.

notes.title: Traps and hazards
notes.body: Dispel All Traps strip your buffs and Blade, Piercing and Bludgeon Vulnerability Traps weaken your defences. Corroding Bile (75 acid) and Virulent Air (45 fire) burn every few seconds. Wailing Statues, Eyes of the Watcher and the Strange Device cast spells at you.
